subject: Mid-cycle capacity change — invoice waterfall & VAT guidance
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@asterialabs.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: procure@asterialabs.com
Date: 2026-09-28T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Request: invoice for mid-cycle seat increase (PO 4567)

Hi Jonas,

We increased our reserved seats mid-month (effective 2026-09-20) and procurement asked for a formal invoice that shows the partial-period charges so we can route payment through our AP team. Details below: 

- Existing committed seats: 12 (monthly)
- New reserved seats added: +8 (effective 2026-09-20)
- Add-ons: +500 GB storage (started 2026-09-20)
- Contract: Annual commit, PO attached (PO_4567_Asteria.pdf)
- Billing contact: procure@asterialabs.com
- Payment terms requested: Net 30
- VAT / tax: Asteria is based in Germany; procurement asks whether Redwood will apply VAT or if reverse-charge can be used (we have a VAT id on file).

Can you send a proforma or interim invoice that clearly shows the prorated charges and VAT treatment so we can approve the PO quickly? Also confirm final invoice and payment instructions.

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Head of Cloud Ops
Asteria Labs

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@asterialabs.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-28T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: invoice for mid-cycle seat increase (PO 4567)

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear note and the PO. I've looped in Kim (sales ops) and Marcus (finance) to prepare a proforma that itemizes the partial-month capacity and storage add-on. A couple quick clarifications so we calculate the waterfall correctly:

- Can you confirm whether the 8 seats are all committed seats (i.e., reserved capacity) or a burst/ephemeral pool? You noted "reserved" but want to confirm for billing classification.
- Confirm Asteria's EU VAT ID you referenced so Marcus can evaluate reverse-charge eligibility. If you prefer not to paste it here, we can accept it via procurement email.
- Is net 30 acceptable if we issue an interim proforma now, followed by a month-end consolidated invoice? Or would you prefer a single interim invoice that you can pay immediately?

Once I have those answers we will generate a proforma PDF and a breakdown spreadsheet. Expect the proforma within 24 business hours.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0197

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-29T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: invoice for mid-cycle seat increase (PO 4567) — proposed approach

Team — proposed waterfall to keep Asteria's AP happy and to minimize our re-billing work: 

1) Issue a proforma interim invoice (non-posted) dated 2026-09-20 that shows: 
   - Prorated charge for +8 seats for 11 days (9/20–9/30) at their committed rate
   - Prorated charge for +500 GB storage for 11 days
   - Reference PO_4567 and include net 30 terms
2) Tax handling: because Asteria provided an EU VAT ID in the customer record, finance will apply reverse-charge (no VAT on our invoice) but we must include the customer VAT number and the reverse-charge note. Marcus, confirm we have the VAT id in Stripe/CRM.
3) At month-end we will issue the regular September invoice that consolidates the monthly committed seats and the interim charges (interim will be credited on the month-end invoice to avoid double-billing).

Attachments: I ran a quick calculation (waterfall_calc.xlsx) showing per-seat/day math and the interim line items. I recommend sending the proforma PDF to procure@asterialabs.com and include a docusign link for approval to expedite PO matching.

Marcus — can you produce the proforma and confirm the account VAT id? Also confirm whether AP prefers a standalone invoice for immediate payment versus a proforma and net-30 on the month-end invoice.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@asterialabs.com>, procure@asterialabs.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-01T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Proforma and payment instructions for PO 4567 (mid-cycle seat increase)

Hi Olivia / AP team — attaching the requested proforma and a short breakdown. See the highlights below and attachments: proforma-AL-4567.pdf (interim proforma), waterfall_calc.xlsx (internal calc), PO_4567_Asteria.pdf (from you).

Summary (interim proforma dated 2026-09-20):
- Prorated seats (8 seats, 2026-09-20 to 2026-09-30): EUR 2,880.00
- Prorated storage (500 GB, same dates): EUR 45.00
- Subtotal interim: EUR 2,925.00
- VAT: 0.00 (reverse-charge)
- Total due (proforma): EUR 2,925.00

Notes and next steps: 
- We applied reverse-charge based on the VAT id on file. Please confirm the VAT id on the proforma matches your procurement record. If you prefer us to charge VAT instead, let us know immediately.
- This proforma is payable on receipt (we can accept immediate payment) or we can apply the interim amount as a credit on the month-end invoice and honor Net 30. Please indicate which option AP prefers; if no preference, we'll automatically apply it as an interim invoice payable on receipt to avoid month-end reconciliation delays.
- Payment methods: wire (preferred), ACH (US accounts), or credit card. Wire instructions are in the attached proforma. For EU customers we can also accept SEPA — see payment section in PDF.
- For PO matching, include the proforma number PRO-AL-4567 in the payment reference.
- Approval: if you'd like a signed confirmation, here's the DocuSign link: https://docusign.net/some-doc-id

If everything looks correct, I'll mark the proforma as posted and email accounting for collection.

Best regards,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0197
